title: Postexercise Hot-Water Immersion on Exercise Performance in Hypoxia
official: Effect of Five Days of Postexercise Hot-Water Immersion on Exercise Performance in Hypoxia
summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the effect of 5 days post-exercise hot water immersion on exercise performance at simulated altitude.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Physically active (minimum of 90 minutes of moderate-intensity exercise per week)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Cardiovascular disease
* resident of \>1500 m above sea-level in the past year;
* history of fainting
